rules.statement: SPTLC1 pathogenic variants at Ser331, including p.Ser331Phe and p.Ser331Tyr, are associated with severe childhood-onset motor and sensory neuropathy (generally without skin ulceration as in classic HSAN1A), and a p.Ser331Tyr individual reported in juvenile ALS was most likely a severe early-onset form of HSN.
rules.exceptions: One individual with a Ser331 variant was reported to have skin ulceration.

sources.quote: SPTLC1 pathogenic variants at Ser331, including p.Ser331Phe [Suh et al 2014] and p.Ser331Tyr [Rotthier et al 2009, Auer-Grumbach 2013], are associated with severe childhood-onset motor and sensory neuropathy (generally without skin ulceration as in classic HSAN1A).

sources.quote: An individual with pathogenic variant p.Ser331Tyr was included in a description of SPTLC1-related juvenile ALS by Johnson et al [2021]. The described syndrome was caused by toxic sphingolipids and sensory involvement was demonstrated; thus, it was most likely a severe early-onset form of HSN.

items.item: Condition: the rule is about SPTLC1 variants that affect protein residue 331.
items.reason: Quote [1] explicitly refers to SPTLC1 pathogenic variants at Ser331, including p.Ser331Phe and p.Ser331Tyr.

items.item: Conclusion: such variants point to neuropathy, hereditary sensory and autonomic, type 1A (also called: HSAN1A; SPTLC1 hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathy type 1; hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathy type 1 caused by mutation in SPTLC1; neuropathy, hereditary sensory and autonomic, type IA) rather than amyotrophic lateral sclerosis 27, juvenile (also called: ALS27; SPTLC1 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; SPTLC1-ALS; SPTLC1-associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; SPTLC1-related amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis caused by mutation in SPTLC1; juvenile amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 27).
items.reason: The quotes support severe childhood-onset motor/sensory neuropathy and reinterpret one juvenile ALS case as likely HSN, but they do not state that all Ser331 variants point to HSAN1A rather than ALS27.

items.item: Scope: this is stated as a general association for such SPTLC1 variants, not only for a single reported patient or family, and not only as a difference in frequency between patient groups.
items.reason: Quote [1] frames Ser331 variants generally as associated with the neuropathy phenotype, not merely as a single case/family or a frequency difference.

review.reason: Generalized from a single reclassified case / individual report.
